normal-supported.condition: Run on Linux with the frozen repository dependency graph.

integration-local.condition: Run only after the named local fixture, service, browser, or container prerequisite is available.
integration-local.reason: Requires integration infrastructure beyond the normal supported lane.

upstream-compatibility.condition: Run during an explicitly directed upstream reconciliation or compatibility audit.
upstream-compatibility.reason: Protects inherited compatibility rather than the required normal OpenCraw result.

platform-specific.condition: Run on the operating system or native toolchain named by the test.
platform-specific.reason: The assertion is intentionally conditional on a non-canonical platform.

live-provider.condition: Run only with explicitly approved live credentials and provider access.
live-provider.reason: Uses a live provider or credential-dependent interface.

release-publication.condition: Run only in an explicitly authorized release, signing, packaging, or publication validation turn.
release-publication.reason: Exercises release or publication machinery outside the normal supported lane.

expensive-manual.condition: Run only when its expensive fixture, benchmark, or manual scenario is specifically requested.
expensive-manual.reason: The workload is intentionally excluded from routine supported validation.

quarantined.condition: Do not run until its active tracking record is resolved and the entry is reclassified.
quarantined.reason: Temporary quarantine; entries require an individual tracking reference.

project-diagnostic.condition: Run through pnpm test or the owning Vitest/native project during a broad diagnostic investigation.
project-diagnostic.reason: Owned by an inherited project configuration outside the compact supported lane.
